label: copy phase (from 3rd output on), echoed input is m/1/e/v/j/0
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step), almost entirely from recall_idx >= 2, and only when the input token is a repeat (in_first=0). Rate is highest around recall_idx 3-5 and absolute steps t=11-13. Within that window, input-token identity drives it: m (31% rate, ~30% of mass, includes the strongest activations, e.g. m echoed at recall_idx 2), then 1, e, v, j, 0. The token being output also matters (j, m, v, i, a, u raise the rate), so the response looks like a graded token-dependent sum, not a clean category. Predicate gets dev F1 ~0.53 and mass recall ~0.73. It misses lower-magnitude firings on other tokens, and many copy steps with these tokens stay inactive, especially late in long sequences.
